blocks.label: subsec:pde-without-solutions

blocks.en: Every now and then a paper appears with a title like "A method to solve all partial differential equations." The content of such papers is always very far from satisfying the claims made in the title. It is rumored that a paper of this kind inspired Lewy to construct his famous example of a linear PDE which has no solutions at all. This example also highlights the importance of analyticity in the Cauchy-Kovalevskaya result.
blocks.zh: 不时会出现标题类似"求解所有偏微分方程的一种方法"的论文. 这类论文的内容总是远远达不到标题中的宣称. 据说, 一篇这样的论文启发 Lewy 构造了他著名的完全无解的线性偏微分方程例子. 这个例子也突出了 Cauchy-Kovalevskaya 结果中解析性的重要性.

blocks.en: We note that when $f$ is analytic, the Cauchy-Kovalevskaya theorem applies and noncharacteristic initial-value problems for \eqref{eq:lewy-inhomogeneous-equation} have local solutions. In contrast, for nonanalytic $f$ there may be no solutions, even if no initial conditions are prescribed.
blocks.zh: 注意, 当 $f$ 解析时, 可以应用 Cauchy-Kovalevskaya 定理, \eqref{eq:lewy-inhomogeneous-equation} 的非特征初值问题具有局部解. 相比之下, 对非解析的 $f$, 即使不指定初始条件, 也可能无解.

blocks.en: Likewise, for given $(c_1,c_3,\ldots,c_k)$ there is at most one value $c_2=c_2(c_1,c_3,\ldots,c_k)$ for which \eqref{eq:lewy-inhomogeneous-equation} can have a solution in any neighborhood of $(x_2,y_2,z_2)$. Now restrict $c_i$ to a set of $l$ elements, $l>k$. There are $l^k$ possible choices of $(c_1,\ldots,c_k)$. However, there are at most $kl^{k-1}$ choices for which any of the relations $c_1=c_1(c_2,\ldots,c_k)$, $c_2=c_2(c_1,c_3,\ldots,c_k)$, etc. hold. Hence there are choices for which \eqref{eq:lewy-inhomogeneous-equation} has no solutions in any neighborhood of any of the points $(x_i,y_i,z_i)$. In fact, if $l$ is large relative to $k$, this will be the case for "most" choices of the $c_i$.
blocks.zh: 类似地, 给定 $(c_1,c_3,\ldots,c_k)$ 时, 至多有一个值 $c_2=c_2(c_1,c_3,\ldots,c_k)$, 使 \eqref{eq:lewy-inhomogeneous-equation} 在 $(x_2,y_2,z_2)$ 的某个邻域内可能有解. 现在将 $c_i$ 限制在含有 $l$ 个元素的集合中, 其中 $l>k$. $(c_1,\ldots,c_k)$ 有 $l^k$ 种可能选择. 然而, 使关系 $c_1=c_1(c_2,\ldots,c_k)$, $c_2=c_2(c_1,c_3,\ldots,c_k)$ 等中的任意一个成立的选择至多有 $kl^{k-1}$ 种. 因而存在这样的选择, 使 \eqref{eq:lewy-inhomogeneous-equation} 在各点 $(x_i,y_i,z_i)$ 的任意邻域内都无解. 事实上, 如果 $l$ 相对于 $k$ 很大, 则 $c_i$ 的"大多数"选择都具有这一性质.

blocks.en: Let $\Omega$ be a domain in $\mathbb{C}$, symmetric with respect to the real axis. Let $f$ be holomorphic in $\Omega\cap\{\operatorname{Im}z>0\}$ and continuous on $\Omega\cap\{\operatorname{Im}z\geq0\}$. Moreover, assume that $f$ takes real values on $\Omega\cap\{\operatorname{Im}z=0\}$. Show that $f$ can be extended to a function that is holomorphic in all of $\Omega$ by setting $f(z)=\overline{f(\bar z)}$ for $\operatorname{Im}z<0$. Hint: Show that $\int_Cf(z)\,\mathrm{d}z=0$ for any closed rectifiable curve $C$ such that $C$ and its interior lie in $\Omega$. It suffices to show this when $C$ is a triangle.
blocks.zh: 设 $\Omega$ 为 $\mathbb{C}$ 中关于实轴对称的区域. 设 $f$ 在 $\Omega\cap\{\operatorname{Im}z>0\}$ 内全纯, 在 $\Omega\cap\{\operatorname{Im}z\geq0\}$ 上连续. 此外, 假设 $f$ 在 $\Omega\cap\{\operatorname{Im}z=0\}$ 上取实值. 证明, 对 $\operatorname{Im}z<0$ 定义 $f(z)=\overline{f(\bar z)}$, 就可将 $f$ 延拓为整个 $\Omega$ 内的全纯函数. Hint: 证明, 对任意闭的可求长曲线 $C$, 若 $C$ 及其内部均位于 $\Omega$ 内, 则 $\int_Cf(z)\,\mathrm{d}z=0$. 只需对 $C$ 为三角形的情形证明这一点.
blocks.label: ex:schwarz-reflection-principle
